rawContent: Please be safe out there, Family. #BlackLivesMatter

@kellycutrone @UncleRUSH Thank you @kellycutrone for your courage in coming forward with  your #MeToo experience as a survivor of attempted rape by serial predator, Russell Simmons (@UncleRUSH) and for your brave participation in the @OnTheRecordDoc on @hbomax.

This young woman showed tremendous grace under pressure. I pray that she is being supported and lifted up in order to process the grief and trauma of documenting the murder of  #GeorgeFloyd ✊🏽💔#BlackLivesMatter

@ClintSmithIII You’re a Black woman who is raped. You’re told it’s your fault. Being Black in America is a pre-existing condition that makes us more vulnerable across the board without support or acknowledgement of the knee on our necks. #BlackLivesMatter #MeToo The status quo is killing us.
@jamiaw Same. I have one kidney, and my son has severe asthma. I wish I could be there, too. I am so grateful to the protestors who are insisting that #BlackLivesMatter ✊🏽✊🏼✊🏿✊🏾

America has arrested THOUSANDS of protestors to avoid arresting THREE accessories to murder. 

#BlackLivesMatter  #JusticeForGeorgeFloyd
Thank you for shining a light on our stories and the need to protect Black women in this beautiful piece @kelleent #MeToo #BlackLivesMatter
Thank you for having me @DominiqueDaDiva I hope the struggle for Black Liberation will include Black women. #BLM ✊🏽

Thank you @jodikantor for including me in this powerful piece grappling with the signficance of this moment in history. As a survivor of both rape and racism in America, I truly hope that meaningful change is coming. #BlackLivesMatter #MeToo

@MurjaniRawls @Sil_Lai @SheriSher_Bx Thank you so much for this powerful piece @MurjaniRawls. I hope that Black women aren't left out of the #MeToo movement, and I hope that Black women aren't left out of the #BlackLivesMatter movement, either. We deserve respect, safety and compassion, too.
@joecoscarelli @OnTheRecordDoc Thank you @joecoscarelli @melenar @jodikantor for including #BlackWomen in the #MeToo movement by reporting our stories.
Black Women Speak Out About #MeToo and the Music Industry In 'On the Record' - VICE https://t.co/SFXWXagHul
@freeblackgirl Thank you for sharing this. Many friends, especially Black women, are in a lot of pain right now, feeling unseen and unsafe in both the #MeToo and #BLM movements.

This pregnant woman was tased in the stomach by police. She was not under arrest. She did not pose a threat of any kind. The woman later miscarried. #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter #ProtectBlackWomen
@ms_gabbye It certainly does hold up, a little too well. #MeToo

The arrest of #GhislaineMaxwell is so gratifying. I feel a sense of relief in my whole entire soul. I do not know any of the #Epstein survivors and was not expecting that, but the betrayal of the enablers, especially when they are women, cuts to the bone. #MeToo

I’m so sorry I left your album unfinished @KaliRanks. I couldn’t wait to work with you when I signed you in 1995, but when @UncleRUSH raped me my world crumbled. I’m so sorry I abandoned you and your music. I’m sorry I left you in the dark for 22 years, until I said #MeToo

All 3 of the deceased women in this photo were serving others. 

#VanessaGuillen was serving her country. #BreonnaTaylor was an EMT caring for Covid patients. #ToyinSalau was a #BlackLivesMatter protestor.

How will we serve them? Who will serve and save our women and girls?
@ZoeCantley Thank you so much @ZoeCantley for the opportunity to talk about the pain and conflict of Black women who find themselves at the intersection of #BlackLivesMatter and #MeToo.

Since you invoke #MeToo and discuss journalists of color ⁦@soledadobrien⁩, why do you think most Black journalists have chosen to ignore the serial rape of several Black women by Russell Simmons? 

Thank you as always, for your courage and candor. https://t.co/JAc0Ju6x40

@jurneesmollett @Sil_Lai @AlexiaNortonJo1 @SheriSher_Bx Thank you so much @jurneesmollett. 💗💗

Black women seem to be getting lost in both #MeToo and #BlackLivesMatter, so your support of me, @Sil_Lai, @SheriSher_Bx and @OnTheRecordDoc means everything.✊🏽✊🏽✊🏽✊🏽

I’m deeply inspired by the way you refuse to be silenced @ejeancarroll. 

#MeToo ✊🏽✊🏻

@JarrettHill @FANTIPodcast @TrevellAnderson @hbomax Then you @JarrettHill and @TrevellAnderson for having me on @FANTIPodcast and for shining a light on the unseen pain of Black women survivors. #MeToo #BlackLivesMatter 💗✊🏽

Misogyny destroys careers and inflicts trauma.

As we address systemic injustice let’s examine the white patriarchy as a whole, because that’s the only entity that the police truly protect and serve.

#BlackLivesMatter #MeToo

“A must-watch... No documentary has so powerfully connected #MeToo and #BlackLivesMatter. MeToo has yielded a number of documentaries but a strikingly intersectional perspective makes this searing account of sexual abuse in the hiphop industry a landmark.” https://t.co/6qpEcHK2g5
Congratulations @AshleyJudd Thank you for your bravery. #MeToo

We’ve crossed the Rubicon. 

#BlackLivesMatter  #KyleRittenhouse

Everyone I know who is Black is in deep pain right now, but pretending to be okay, because that’s how we do. And when they start killing white people with impunity, it’s beyond painful. It’s terrifying. We are in pain and gravely concerned. #BlackLivesMatter #KyleRittenhouse

This is utterly exhausting. 

#BlackLivesMatter #KyleRittenhouse #COVID19 #HurricaneLaura #Election2020
Thank you @RepSpeier #MeToo

The medical examiner declared the death of #BreonnaTaylor a homicide, yet no one is being charged with “homiciding” her? 

“Wanton endangerment”?? 

GTFOH. Make it make fucking sense. #BlackLivesMatter
#MeToo in the music industry is going to be devastating.
#MeToo

This WHOLE THREAD is a word ... 

And the Cishetero Black men tripping over Black women to play house with Karen talmbout #BlackLivesMatter is a LOT.

I have been disappointed for thee last time and am now officially accepting applications from yt men. Please Retweet, because 🙄.

@GerrickKennedy I wish someone could draw a picture of men and women like @MarciaLDyson holding #BlackLivesMatter signs standing on the backs and bodies of @theestallion, R. Kelly survivors, Russell Simmons survivors and all Black women who’ve been abused. That’s what their hypocrisy looks like.

@JarrettHill The thing I hated about myself the most was the fact that I’m a rape survivor. I suppressed it and hid it and created a persona for myself that had nothing to do with that part of my life. When #MeToo happened I was forced to face it, and I unlocked a strength I never knew I had.
Come on @Stanford We can and *must* do so much better than this. I’m a PROUD @StanfordAlumni and #ChocolateCardinal and expect so much more from my alma mater. 🌲🌲🌲#MeToo
@meenaharris Busy selling #BlackLivesMatter t-shirts for the NFL that won’t hire  @Kaepernick7
How the Directors of #OnTheRecord Built Trust with Their Subject https://t.co/fVoyFbNa2v via @indiewire Thank you @TambayObenson and @Carlos_Film #MeToo
Thank you @remhq and Michael Stipe. 😭❤️✊🏽 #MeToo
@sjs856 Saying #BlackLivesMatter also makes people nervous. So there’s that.
I’m going to work on my book as a distraction from Twitter today instead of the other way around. Oh and ... #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/lLPNPNTsow

@ohwell2allofyou @youngsinick @staceyabrams The data shows that #BlackLivesMatter  protests, including those that called to #DefundThePolice, drove increased voter registration and Democratic turnout => BidenHarris getting 81 million votes. 

I don’t get what’s funny about that. No 🧢.
If you haven’t seen @OnTheRecordDoc here’s a link where you can see it for free. Thanks so much for your time and support. #ProtectBlackWomen #MeToo #BlackLivesMatter
Thank you @NickKristof #ProtectChildren #MeToo
If you truly believe that #BlackLivesMatter please read this thread and sign this petition: https://t.co/GUyaXGQJRe

This is heartbreaking. Daisy Coleman was raped and then bullied for coming forward. She took her own life. Daisy’s mother, Melinda has now died by suicide leaving behind a grieving husband and son. Please support them if you can. 💔💔💔😡 #MeToo
Thank you for having me @TheWrap @TheWrapWomen  #MeToo #BlackLivesMatter #ProtectBlackWomen
We must #DefundThePolice precisely because #BlackLivesMatter If you’ve got a less snappy slogan that will save more Black lives, please proceed.

“Few other #MeToo films have dared to confront the insidious culture of silence embedded in the Black community than this searing documentary. @OnTheRecordDoc shines a spotlight on how Black women are routinely sidelined in this urgent dialogue.” - @ReelTalker Thank you, Candice.
Love to see it. Go girls. #MeToo
If you care about #MeToo please read this whole thread. Thank you @bmluse for talking about the professional, financial and emotional toll of sexual harassment in the workplace.

“No documentary that I’ve seen on the by-now long arc of the #MeToo movement approaches the fallout of publicly revealing one’s story of sexual violence with more nuance and psychological acuity than On the Record.” - ⁦@adrian_horton⁩ https://t.co/sa3eEAKBvu

They already released the guy who stole Pelosi's lectern.

Kalief Browder was not so lucky. He spent 2 yrs in solitary confinement awaiting a trial having been accused of stealing a backpack (not the Speaker's lectern). At the age of 22, Kalief died by suicide. #BlackLivesMatter

Thank you @BirdsEyeViewFF for talking with us about the making of @OnTheRecordDoc, a film that almost didn’t make it to viewers. I’m so grateful to @hbomax for stepping in to distribute this film. Please watch the movie and check out the discussion below. #metoo #BlackLivesMatter

@menkesfilm I hope things are different post #MeToo but am not so sure. A lot of these predators seem to be laying low until the dust settles. I think they assume that society will eventually forget the pain they caused and the careers they destroyed. I hope they’re wrong.
#MeToo in the music industry. Prayers up for all survivors.
If you believe #BlackLivesMatter or if you love hip hop, or if you care about violence against women or #MeToo you should lift up Dee Barnes (@sistadbarnes) in tangible ways, today and every day.
@AOC I'm so grateful for your courage and your voice @AOC. Thank you. Sending you so much love. #MeToo
#MeToo
Thank you @esmebianco #MeToo

I did watch the whole interview -  in horror - a few days after @Oprah abandoned @OnTheRecordDoc. 

Do not to attempt to shame me @GayleKing. Stop turning the tables. Attacking survivors enables and emboldens abusers. #MeToo

Why are you shaming me @GayleKing? 

You said the allegations of rape against Russell Simmons must be considered in the “context of the times.” What does that mean? 

Your BFF came on your show to say there are inconsistencies in my story. What is she talking about? 

#MeToo

I wonder why @GayleKing felt the need to #MeToo Kobe Bryant following his tragic death but is shaming me and making excuses for Russell Simmons, a man credibly accused of being a serial rapist. Are you a feminist unless the rapist is your friend? https://t.co/HYzPYTzFGB
This is why I won't back down. #MeToo #BlackLivesMatter
I hope the women he harmed get justice. 🤎🤎🤎#MeToo

Today I'll be watching #AllenVFarrow on @hbomax, the new series from the directors of @OnTheRecordDoc. The cult of celebrity has enabled decades of abuse by men like Woody Allen and Russell Simmons. I'm so proud of Amy Ziering & Kirby Dick for taking this on. #MeToo
Sending love to @RealDylanFarrow I don’t know you, but I have some idea how terrifying this moment is. You’ve already survived the hardest part. This is the part where you set yourself free. #MeToo
Your courage inspires me @RealDylanFarrow and as a mother @MiaFarrow has my deepest respect. #MeToo #AllenVFarrow

And yet, Black people didn't storm the Capitol. #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter 
Both at the same time. #JusticeForDanielPrude
#JusticeforMartinGugino and #DefundThePolice and #BlackLivesMatter

We need solidarity to overcome rape culture. That’s why I fought for @OnTheRecordDoc even after @Oprah abandoned it. I hope you’ll encourage everyone to watch the film, because after 400 years of abuse, Black women survivors deserve 95 minutes to be seen. #MeToo #BlackLivesMatter

I hope the organizers of the #WeAsOurselves campaign didn’t exclude me and the other Black survivors featured in @OnTheRecordDoc, because @Oprah abandoned the film. That would be a shame. We must unite to overcome rape culture. This is about a movement, not a movie. #MeToo

“Here’s the thing about these abusers: There are always signs. The more power they amass, the more power we give them with celebrity worship ... the more invincible they feel. Their brazenness is only amplified by their ability to avoid repercussions.” - @DavidDTSS  #MeToo
Sometimes you have to look OUT for the helpers. 🥴 #MeToo

Rapists aren’t rapey all the time. They have friends, sometimes powerful friends, who will say things like there are “inconsistencies” in your story even when there aren’t. That’s why victims don’t come forward, and that’s what predators are counting on. #MeToo

It’s the retribution for me. I think of Jessica, the young woman who was raped as a teen at knifepoint by Nikki Minaj’s husband. Jessica has been hunted and harassed for years, as if the injury of the assault was not cruel enough. We must do better. #ProtectBlackWomen #MeToo

@50Lux14 Black women lost our bodily autonomy in the Atlantic Slave Trade, so there’s not even a baseline expectation that we’re pure or that we deserve protection and respect. We must be intentional in order to reclaim our safety and dignity, and it must be all hands on deck. #MeToo

Without bystanders who excuse and deflect, the #MeToo  predators couldn’t get away with it. 

I’m throwing it back to high school Shakespeare class for a hashtag to describe the enablers.

#EtTu Diane Keaton
#EtTu Alec Baldwin

It's not complicated.

Don't sexually assault or harass anyone. #MeToo 
Don't make excuses for people who do. #EtTu
Sweeping this behavior under the rug in the Black community is hurting... the Black community. #MeToo
This is a whole word: “Lip Service Leadership.” You have my respect and my support @kdc_md @drjessigold Thank you. #MeToo
I deeply respect your commitment to survivors @drjessigold. Please take care of yourself. I will be here if and when you need me. #MeToo

A suggestion: Less focus on awards shows and more focus on actual sexual harassment and rape.  #MeToo seems to be the hashtag for survivors and may not share the intention of #TimesUp. I trust organizations like @equalitynow @BlackWomensBP that protected women before it was cool.

@BgirlJukeboxx @Oprah The exploitation of Black bodies didn’t just end because slavery ended. It morphed into different forms, and we internalized it. We must break the cycle of rape culture in general, and we must address the way our trauma exacerbates it in our community, in particular. #MeToo

@1stMANwasBLK @BgirlJukeboxx @Oprah Your Tweet implied that it has to be either/or, but we can actually call out Donald Trump for being a rapist and Russell Simmons for being a rapist. At the same time. #MeToo

@1stMANwasBLK @BgirlJukeboxx @Oprah @ejeancarroll I’m not scared of any of them. I was silent for 22 years out of loyalty to my race, but now I am loyal to myself, to my fellow survivors and to the truth. #MeToo And yes, let’s keep the same energy for all of the sexual predators.

@WrittenByHanna @BrookeObie This is heartbreaking but not surprising, as @TamikaDMallory also stays caping for Russell Simmons. I would love to be wrong, but she does not appear to be here for #BlackLivesMatter or to #ProtectBlackWomen She appears to be leveraging those movements to advance herself.

The exit of @Oprah from @OnTheRecordDoc is having a  chilling effect on survivors today. They DM me. They are watching. They’re scared. Predators are watching, too, and they may be emboldened. 

So, I want #DemiLovato and every survivor to know that you’re not alone. #MeToo

This is precisely why I fought so hard for @OnTheRecordDoc What’s at stake is so much bigger than my story. The film shines a long overdue spotlight on the layers of additional obstacles that fail to protect Black women before and after assaults. #MeToo

@drjessigold @mclemoremr I just worry about survivors who reach out to #TimesUp expecting support when in fact the organization calculates which survivors they will support and which survivors they will silence (or at least, mute) depending on who the rapist is how it serves the founders. 😠💔 #MeToo

@toxicfemininit2 @OnTheRecordDoc We are not alone anymore. Survivors don’t need the permission of gatekeepers to break our silence anymore. We have our voices and our truth, and we have each other. #MeToo

The ZEAL with which people want to rationalize the murder of #MaKhiaByrant is ... fascinating. 

#DefundThePolice 
#AbolishThePolice 
#BlackLivesMatter

This was 100% a factor in my decision. I knew the #MeToo window would close, so I wanted to tell my story after decades of silence while I had a rare moment to be believed. I also hoped to encourage more Black survivors to join the conversation before it was too late.
Do better @verzuzonline #ProtectBlackWomen #MeToo

Thank you @MrErnestOwens I appreciate you so much. Sexual assault in the Black community must not be normalized. Black women deserve better. Black music deserves better. Black culture deserves better. Black people deserve better. #MeToo

I appreciate the nuance and pain with which @jaleelwhite discusses the fall of his mentor, Bill Cosby. Before Russell Simmons raped me, he was a mentor to me, too. It’s crushing. It’s complicated. It’s a loss, but these men caused irreparable harm. That’s just the truth. #MeToo

So proud of ⁦⁦@mamidok⁩. I was with her when she discovered this violation by a trusted @Stanford administrator. I hope ⁦@SNBAA⁩ will finally stand with the survivors instead of enabling this abuser, even if it is 30 years too late. #MeToo  https://t.co/pHPUYyfaSg

The brave and brilliant woman who wrote this piece is my best friend @mamidok and thanks to your advocacy @mldauber, she is finally being protected and respected by @Stanford @SNBAA 

#MeToo #ProtectBlackWomen

Tonight at 7pm ET we will ask: Are Black women any safer one year after @OnTheRecordDoc? 

Please join @DavidDTSS @msshanitarenee @TonjaStidhum @craigspoplife @briggsjimmie @DDotOmen @professordaddyo tonight at 7pm ET on @TwitterSpaces to discuss. #MeToo https://t.co/6SLLCk13G5
@AmyLEngland Thank you, Amy, and YES. #MeToo
Thank you @DavidDTSS #MeToo #BlackSurvivorsMatter
Not a good look @HowardU #ProtectBlackWomen #MeToo

“What we cannot do is leave each other behind. Even when it is appropriate to maintain a minimum safe distance apart, we’ve all got to keep talking to one another, because as a people, we are all that we have.” - @LonnaeONeal #Cosby #MeToo

I’m here to tell you  #MeToo did not go too far. Saw this picture on Instagram, and it’s so depressing. [The comments on top of the photo are mine. The original photo was posted by @KevinLiles1, who appears in the photo with Russell Simmons.] https://t.co/nqt1hezrXs
Love to see this. Now do Russell Simmons. #MeToo

Sending love to @ClosureJustice4 
#MeToo 💔👊🏽
You’re truly fierce @thekatkendall Thank you for speaking out for all of us survivors #MeToo #HarveyWeinstein #DonaldTrump #RussellSimmons #BillCosby
The stigma and shame is so hard to overcome for all victims of sexual assault, but for men, it’s even harder. I’m so proud of these brave survivors for coming forward. #MeToo #MenToo

When you have a pair of Phylicia Rashads in your own family, it’s a whole lot. And when you idolized them, while they gaslit you and enabled your abusers. And that was long before I ever met Russell Simmons. Let’s break this cycle. I’m tired. #MeToo

When you go to a funeral where well-intentioned family friends applaud you for being brave and saying #MeToo and then, make small-talk about two men who harmed you before you ever heard the name, Russell Simmons, that’s a whole lot, too.

Setting boundaries since I said #MeToo. The toxic people keep exposing themselves, and they keep getting voted off my island (by me). But it’s a whole pandemic, so it’s hard to meet new (healthy) people. I’m not letting the toxic people back in, but daaayum. Talk me through it.

I learned the hard way (when I was led into the #TimesUp glue trap) that TimesUp isn’t pro-survivor. They’re pro-well-connected-predators, and they’ll catch & kill the story of survivors who enlist their help to call out one of their faves. #MeToo  https://t.co/TysWfZpdQi
I'm in awe of the courage of @VRSVirginia and am sending her respect, support, and love. #MeToo

Rape and rape enabling is unacceptable. Even when it’s your favorite rapper. Or your favorite rapper’s husband. Or your favorite rap mogul. Or your favorite comedian. Or your favorite actor. Or your favorite singer. Or your favorite director. Or your favorite politician. #MeToo

@drjessigold I don’t know who that staff person is, but her quote is spot on. Organizations like @equalitynow @BlackWomensBP @RAINN have been standing with survivors for decades, long before #MeToo became a trending hashtag.

I thought standing up to Russell Simmons 2 decades after he raped me would be terrifying. I had no idea that standing up to the powerful women enabling him would be even harder. @TIMESUPNOW nearly destroyed me, but I survived with my truth, talent and integrity in tact. #MeToo

@VanessaCTyson @TIMESUPNOW They tried to break me and gaslight me, so I would back out of @OnTheRecordDoc. I was already terrified about being in the film, but when the most prominent #MeToo  champions turned on me 15 days before Sundance, I was devastated. It was cruel and anti-survivor in every way.

When powerful women enable abusive men, it gives predators cover to maneuver their way back into polite society:

Russell Simmons returns to Hamptons scene after #MeToo allegations https://t.co/A6omKoex9Z via @pagesix

Why hasn’t ⁦@TIMESUPNOW⁩ said a peep about the return of serial rapist Russell Simmons?#TimesUp was founded to support the victims of powerful sexual predators, so their silence regarding Russell Simmons is … weird. #MeToo  https://t.co/jyedBjXl4Q

Why aren’t @TIMESUPNOW @TinaTchen @MeTooMVMT @TaranaBurke @weasourselves speaking out about the return of serial predator Russell Simmons? More than 10 victims have shared vetted accounts of rape by @UncleRush, yet the most prominent #MeToo advocates are silent as he resurfaces?

I’m sorry you weren’t supported @LindseyBoylan Sadly, the hypocrisy of @TIMESUPNOW has undermined the #MeToo movement. In Jan 2020 @TinaTchen seemed more focused on muting a film exposing Russell Simmons as a rapist than protecting his victims. It was painful and destructive.

The silence of @TIMESUPNOW as serial rapist Russell Simmons resurfaces will embolden predators. 

The revelations of TimesUp’s coordination with Cuomo to mute his victims is toxic. 

If the most prominent #MeToo advocacy group won’t stand up to powerful abusers, what’s the point?

Thank you @sharonwaxman We all owe a huge debt of gratitude to @alisonturkos who built a coalition to call out the tremendous harm being doing by @TIMESUPNOW Our work is not done. The statements from #TimesUp fail to acknowledge their fundamental betrayal of the #MeToo movement.

I agree @alisonturkos The #MeToo movement isn’t about protecting the powerful. It’s about protecting survivors, but when @hilaryr learned I would be quoted in a piece by @eshugerman criticizing @TIMESUPNOW Rosen scolded and bullied me on behalf of @TinaTchen. Rosen must go.

@MoiraDonegan @MHoechstetter The statement from @TinaTchen lacked humility and failed to acknowledge the harm she’s done to the #MeToo movement, and she had the audacity to blame “activists battling each other” when @TIMESUPNOW sucked up money and resources from truly credible activists and organizations.

I was building an app to do exactly that, EverythingDid - In Home Haircare for Our Textures. But when I said #MeToo my life went in a whole different direction. Would still love to do it one day. It’s so needed.

@betterinjeans @LeslieMac Thank you!! I’ll definitely let you know. After #MeToo I had to turn my attention to building and creating content for a dime and a nickel, so I’ve been writing and helping @EllaWylde make music. Maybe one day I can fund EverythingDid my damn self.

@LindseyBoylan Thank you. The really depressing thing is that the return of Russell Simmons was enabled, at least in part, by Oprah’s chaotic exit from @OnTheRecordDoc, which was enabled by Times Up. Abusers thrive in chaos and shadows, which is why true #MeToo allies must be fully transparent.

@Godbold @RichMcHugh Rich is right. If @TIMESUPNOW truly intends to harness the power of #MeToo on behalf of survivors there is no one more qualified to lead than @Godbold,  an expert on trauma informed resources and care, a Weinstein Silence Breaker, and an ethical and transparent activist.
As a survivor of child sex abuse, I felt this testimony from @McKaylaMaroney in my bones. #MeToo

When @Aly_Raisman said "It has become painfully clear to me that a survivor's healing is directly related to the response after coming forward" (paraphrasing while shaking) ... I gasped, because that is the story of my life. God bless these women. #MeToo
Speaking out is how you begin to heal. Yes @McKaylaMaroney And even if you don't have a support system now, don't give up, you will find one. Yes @Aly_Raisman I'm so grateful to these women. #MeToo

I'm not interested in hearing from @tedcruz on the subject of sexual assault. He's helped to ensure that rape victims in Texas are forced to carry pregnancies to term as a result of those rapes. His sanctimonious hypocrisy is not worthy of these brave young women. #MeToo
The story of my childhood.  #MeToo
"I'm so sick from the trauma... It just hits me out of the blue. Just from this testimony ... it might take me months to recover." - @Aly_Raisman #MeToo
Thank you @CoryBooker Yes, we need action. #MeToo

Yes, as @marie_skou reminds us, not all victims become survivors. The courage of @Aly_Raisman @Simone_Biles @McKaylaMaroney @MagsGotSwag12 lifts up every victim of sexual assault - the ones who didn't make it to the Olympics and the ones who didn't make it all. #MeToo
@sjgeimer Yes, you were out there long before there was a #MeToo movement to support you. I’m honored that you follow me on here and am sending you lots of love.

THIS PART: “Starting with an exploration of the history and legacy of slavery’s sexual violence.” 

Thank you @marthasjones_ I cannot wait to read this, because calling out this aspect of the Atlantic Slave Trade will be a #MeToo moment of epic proportions.

.@AppleTV could have released @OnTheRecordDoc, a documentary that centers Black survivors and explores #MeToo in the context of 400 years of sexual violence against Black bodies … but they dropped that and did this instead.

Instead of picking Oprah’s side about a #MeToo movie @TIMESUPNOW should have focused on the #MeToo movement. Their chaotic support of Oprah’s exit from @OnTheRecordDoc created confusion, which Russell Simmons has exploited. The return of a serial rapist is now on their hands.
Congratulations @MichaelaCoel And thank you. 💛💛 #MeToo

@TaranaBurke Thank you @TaranaBurke Your stature in this movement is unmatched, so your response is a big deal. It’s important for Russell Simmons to know from you, not me, that the #MeToo movement is still watching him. I appreciate you very much and look forward to reading your book.

I’m in awe of the courage of the R. Kelly survivors. I hope they find some degree of peace in this moment. I’m also deeply grateful to @dreamhampton for creating a space where Black survivors could be seen. #SurvivingRKelly changed everything for all of us. #MeToo Thank you.

There aren’t enough words to thank @oronike and @K_TishB for their tireless commitment to the R. Kelly survivors and to all Black victims of sexual violence. Their #MuteRKelly movement has transformed the culture. #MuteRKelly #MeToo

I’m so moved by dream’s reference to @OnTheRecordDoc here. This is real solidarity. This is what it looks like to put the #MeToo movement first. This is what it looks like to support Black survivors. This is real courage and integrity. This is everything. Thank you @dreamhampton

Thank you @AnitaHill and welcome to Twitter. Thirty years ago you paved the way for the #MeToo movement that was ultimately ignited on this app, opening a door I walked through to set myself free. You are the original Silence Breaker, and I’m forever in your debt.
Sending love and support to @LiliBernard #MeToo

I was afraid that after saying #MeToo I'd be untouchable, unemployable and totally isolated. In spite of that, I came forward because I was tired of living in fear. 4 years later I'm not isolated. I found a village of people who hold my truth and support me, and it's EVERYTHING.
Thank you @alisonturkos for inviting me to be part of the movement to pass the #AdultSurvivorsAct Your efforts on behalf of victims of sexual violence is breathtaking and endlessly inspiring. #MeToo
Honored to speak on behalf of the #AdultSurvivorsAct with the incredible @DonnaHylton and @EvelynYang Thank you for having us @SafeHorizon and for inviting me @alisonturkos #MeToo
